title: Group member position calculation with bounded variance
description: Implement group member position calculation where each member maintains a position relative to the reference point with bounded variance. Members should have individual random offsets that stay within configurable bounds around the reference point.
close_reason: Implemented RPGM member position calculation in python/src/lichen/sim/mobility.py: add_member() draws each member's individual random offset once via _draw_offset()/:601 (uniform within the max_offset_m disk: magnitude = max_offset_m*sqrt(u), angle uniform), stores it in _offsets, and never redraws; step() then _place_members()/:663 repositions every member at reference_point + offset on each step, so members keep fixed relative geometry while tracking the moving reference point. Offsets are bounded by max_offset_m which doubles as the configurable variance bound and the waypoint inset. Tests in python/tests/sim/test_rpgm.py: test_offsets_bounded_and_drawn_once (offsets stable, |pos-center-offset|=0, magnitude <= bound over 50 steps), test_members_track_reference_point, test_members_stay_within_bounds (100 fast steps), test_seed_reproducibility (offsets and trajectories identical for same seed), test_z_coordinate_propagates, reset/noop/manager tests. Targeted suite 78 passed; full tests/sim/ 1610 passed, 36 skipped; ruff clean; mypy strict clean.
